text.headline: Lauterbrunnen is ruined by 10 am
beats: 25,000 people a day come for one 10-minute waterfall selfie. The streets are jammed 10 am to 8 pm.
By late August Staubbach is a trickle, and the village is voting on charging for the path.
Be there before 9, walk past the falls up the valley, then take the cable car to Mürren.
text.close: Send this to whoever booked Switzerland
